sso.title: SSO sign-in
sso.subtitle: Sign in securely through your enterprise identity provider
sso.emailDescription: Enter your work email and the matching SSO provider is selected automatically
sso.domainDescription: If you know your company domain, you can start SSO with it directly
sso.orgDescription: If you belong to a specific organization, sign in with its name
sso.providerDescription: If you know the exact SSO provider ID, you can use it directly
sso.errorProvider: The specified SSO provider was not found
sso.errorCallback: Something went wrong during authentication. Try again or contact your administrator.
